_comment: Everything here is a recipe, not a credential. Keyless providers are connected automatically. API keys are read from the named env var or prompted for (Enter skips). OAuth providers are opt-in and default to NO. Excluded on purpose: kimi-coding (account bans), sambanova/huggingface/cerebras/vercel-ai-gateway (need a payment card even for the free tier).

keyless.label: DuckDuckGo AI Chat
keyless.note: No account. Serves claude-haiku / gpt mini class models.

keyless.label: Kilo Gateway (anonymous free tier)
keyless.note: Placeholder credential 'anonymous' is Kilo's documented anonymous access, not a secret.

oauth.label: GitHub Copilot (device flow)
oauth.note: Only the gh/auto model works through the gateway, and it is flaky.
